Rosart Rose Glycerin Soap is a handmade cleansing bar enriched with organic Bulgarian rose water, rose oil, rosehip oil and dried Damascena rose petals.

Its glycerin-rich formula gently cleanses while helping the skin retain moisture, leaving it feeling soft, smooth and comfortable.

Suitable for sensitive skin, with a delicate rose fragrance that lingers after use.

Net Weight: 90g

descriptionHtml:
Rosart Rose Oil Revitalizing Essence is a concentrated facial oil treatment presented in convenient, individually sealed capsules.

Formulated with Damascena rose oil, Centifolia rose oil, rosehip oil, grape seed oil, apricot kernel oil and vitamin E, the essence helps nourish and soften the skin while supporting a smoother, more radiant-looking complexion.

Its antioxidant-rich botanical oil blend helps condition the skin and improve the appearance of dryness and dullness, leaving a delicate natural rose aroma.

Each pack contains 30 capsules (350mg each) and a mini pair of scissors for easy opening.

Made in Bulgaria.

Manufactured by Bulgarian Pharma Group Ltd.

Formulated with a blend of rose-derived oils, botanical seed oils and vitamin E.

Individually sealed capsules help provide convenient, measured application.

Includes mini scissors for opening the capsules.

1. Thoroughly cleanse the face and neck.
2. Carefully cut open one capsule using the included mini scissors.
3. Gently squeeze out the concentrated essence.
4. Massage evenly onto the face and neck until absorbed.

Apricot Kernel Oil – Helps nourish and soften the skin.

Grape Seed Oil – A botanical oil with antioxidant properties that helps condition the skin.

Rosehip Oil – Helps maintain skin softness and moisture.

Damascena Rose Oil & Centifolia Rose Oil – Fragrant rose-derived oils that contribute to the essence's botanical formula.

Tocopherol (Vitamin E) – An antioxidant ingredient that helps protect the oils from oxidation.

Composition Per Capsule (350mg)

Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil – 288.4mg

Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil – 37.8mg

Rosa Canina Fruit Oil – 17.5mg

Rosa Damascena Flower Oil – 3.5mg

Tocopherol – 1.75mg

Rosa Centifolia Flower Oil – 1.05mg

Capsule Shell

Gelatin, Glycerin.

descriptionHtml:
Rosart Rose Water is a 100% natural floral water obtained through the distillation of Bulgarian Rosa Damascena rose petals.

This pure, single-ingredient rose water helps soothe, hydrate and refresh the skin, leaving it feeling soft, comfortable and revitalised.

Ideal for daily use as a refreshing facial toner or a gentle addition to your skincare routine.

Made in Bulgaria.
